meta.name: datalad
meta.description: Retrieve, version, and publish scientific datasets with DataLad and git-annex, and capture computational provenance with datalad run, rerun, and containers-run. Use when cloning or fetching data from OpenNeuro, DANDI, datasets.datalad.org, or any DataLad dataset; when a file in a dataset reads as a broken symlink or a small pointer instead of real data; when an analysis needs a machine-readable record of how each output was produced so it can be re-executed; or when publishing a dataset to siblings such as a GitHub repository plus a storage remote. Also use to decide between DataLad and plain Git for a data-carrying repository.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把数据连同它的生成过程一起存档,随时取回并重跑分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有体积大、常更新的科研数据,还想让别人能一键复现你的分析
copy.tagline_en: Version data with how it was made, so any analysis can be re-fetched and re-run
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you hold large, often-updated research data and want others to reproduce your analysis

howto.what: Claude 会改用 DataLad 和 git-annex 来管数据仓库:克隆科学数据集、按需下载文件内容、用 datalad run/rerun 记录并复跑命令,以及把数据发布到 GitHub 加一个存储远端。
howto.when: 当你从 OpenNeuro、DANDI 等来源克隆或获取数据集、文件读出来只是断链或小指针,或需要一份可复跑的分析出处记录时触发。

say.text: 克隆 OpenNeuro 的 ds000001,并取到 T1w 图像内容
say.note: 先 clone,再对需要的路径执行 datalad get

say.text: 用 datalad run 跑这个分析,把命令和输入输出一起记下来
say.note: 生成带 JSON 运行记录的提交

say.text: 把这套数据集发布到 GitHub,同时推一个存储远端

howto.what_en: Claude uses DataLad and git-annex on data repositories: cloning scientific datasets, fetching file content on demand, recording and replaying commands with datalad run/rerun, and publishing to GitHub plus a storage remote.
howto.when_en: Use when cloning or fetching datasets from OpenNeuro, DANDI, and similar sources, when a file reads as a broken symlink or small pointer, or when an analysis needs a re-executable record.

say_en.text: Clone OpenNeuro ds000001 and get the T1w image content
say_en.note: clone first, then datalad get the paths you need

say_en.text: Run this analysis with datalad run, recording command, inputs and outputs
say_en.note: creates a commit with a JSON run record

say_en.text: Publish this dataset to GitHub and push a storage remote too
say_en.note: Git history and data go to separate siblings
